name: Stereo neutrino spectrum of 235U fission rejects sterile neutrino hypothesis

summary.plain: Using its full data set STEREO measured the energy spectrum of antineutrinos from uranium-235 fission with improved precision. The spectrum confirms the old anomaly in the spectrum shape, but the same data reject a light sterile neutrino as its cause, pointing to biases in the nuclear data used for predictions instead.
summary.technical: Full STEREO data set (October 2017 - November 2020): accurate 235U antineutrino energy spectrum that confirms the spectral anomalies, while the segmented detector at ~10 m rejects the light sterile-neutrino hypothesis.

title: Stereo neutrino spectrum of 235U fission rejects sterile neutrino hypothesis
why_it_matters: A new reference measurement of the 235U antineutrino spectrum and a strong disfavouring of the sterile-neutrino explanation of the reactor anomalies.
